title: Element desktop data (Flatpak)
whyItMatters: The Flatpak build keeps the Matrix session, rooms and encryption keys inside its sandbox folder, where a native-only check will not find them.
source: Flatpak sandbox permissions: per-app config lives in ~/.var/app/<app-id>/config; Element's Flathub id is im.riot.Riot: https://docs.flatpak.org/en/latest/sandbox-permissions.html
notes: Same Element profile as the native install. The sandbox folder keeps the old Riot app id even though the app is called Element.
